title: Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU (Theme 7: Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child chooses pa- for an exact place, ku- for a general or far place and mu- for inside, with place nouns in -ni.
representations: a box, a spot on the floor, the playground
steps: Is it a place (-ni or mahali)?
Exact spot, general area, or inside?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Nyumbani mna wageni" and "Mahali hapa pana maji".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." Kwa nini "pana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Pale huchukua pa-, kule huchukua ku-, humu na mle huchukua mu- (m-).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." Kwa nini "ina" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika ngeli ya mahali, kitenzi hupatana na mahali (pa-, ku-, mu-), si na nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili linataja kitu au mahali?
misconceptions.repair: Mahali (-ni) huchukua pa-, ku- au mu-: shuleni kumesafishwa.

misconceptions.ask: Giza liko ndani au mahali fulani tu?
misconceptions.repair: Ndani ya kitu tunatumia mu-: chumbani mna giza.
